methodology: Warm cache; spawn-through-exit wall/CPU; rotated order; explicit per-tool args (otherwise default workers); runtime checks and separate GNU-time RSS samples outside timed intervals. No cache eviction, affinity or governor changes.

input_provenance.synthetic: bench.py shape: 64 functions and 64 absolute relocations per object; archive-lazy selects one member, archive-all selects all members
input_provenance.scope: single-thread exploratory warm-cache probe, shared PC; output files replaced on each run

limitations: Explicit argv inputs are hashed; -l/script/transitive closures require the associated corpus/sysroot provenance.
Single machine and warm cache; no general linker ranking or production qualification.
